markets.name: United States
markets.access: Reg SHO locate requirement; Rule 201 price test after a 10% decline; threshold securities lists; the deepest stock-lending market. No stamp duty; SEC fee on sells is inside the commission figure.
markets.data_notes: Prices from 1980. Screener returns OTC (PNK, OQX) listings; only the five listed exchanges are kept. ADRs of foreign issuers excluded by issuer country.

markets.name: Canada
markets.access: UMIR short-sale marking, no price test since 2012; CDS lending is deep for the composite. No stamp duty.
markets.data_notes: The screener lists NEO (.NE) cross-listings of US names; TOR only, issuer country CA.

markets.name: United Kingdom
markets.access: UK SSR (net short positions above 0.2% disclosed to the FCA, 0.5% public); stamp duty reserve tax 0.5% on purchases, not charged on CFDs or stock borrow returns; deep lending for the FTSE 350.
markets.data_notes: GBp quotes; a few lines quote in GBP or USD and are dropped. IOB and CXE listings excluded.

markets.name: Europe ex-UK (pooled)
markets.msci_note: Portugal and Spain: short selling restricted to certain securities / not an established practice
markets.access: EU SSR: net shorts above 0.1% to the regulator, 0.5% public; locate rule; national FTTs in France, Italy, Spain; Swiss transfer stamp; deep lending in the core markets. Pooled book is multi-currency: returns are in USD, and currency is available as a neutralisation group.
markets.data_notes: German screener returns FRA/MUN/STU duplicates of every Xetra line; GER only. Swiss, Dutch and Polish screens list US cross-listings; issuer country filter removes them.

markets.name: Australia
markets.access: Covered shorts only, daily short-sale reporting to ASIC, published positions; June fiscal year end, semi-annual reporting.
markets.data_notes: Semi-annual statements only for most names: quarterly frames are sparse.

markets.name: Hong Kong (incl. China H shares)
markets.msci_note: China (international) assessed on the HK-listed portion
markets.access: Shorting only in HKEX's designated securities list (about 1,000 names), uptick rule, covered only; stamp duty 0.1% each side; board lots by name; semi-annual reporting.
markets.data_notes: H-shares report in CNY while quoting in HKD (financialCurrency differs from currency).

markets.name: Korea
markets.access: Short selling resumed 31 March 2025 after a 17-month ban; institutions need the mandated internal control and naked-short detection systems and an FSS registration number; uptick rule; per-name daily limits; securities transaction tax 0.15% on sells; foreign investors register (LEI replacing the IRC). MSCI: operational friction remains.
markets.data_notes: Preferred lines (code ending 5, e.g. 005935.KS) are a second share class; one class per issuer kept.

markets.name: Taiwan
markets.access: FINI registration (efficient); shorting restricted to the eligible margin list; the FSC tightened margin and short rules on 26 May 2025 and imposed temporary curbs in April 2025; securities transaction tax 0.3% on sells; daily short-sale volume caps.
markets.data_notes: On EODHD both boards are in: TWSE (TW) and the Taipei Exchange (TWO, 1,098 common stocks, about 440 above $0.5m/day), ranked together by value. On Yahoo the Taipei Exchange was excluded.

markets.name: Brazil
markets.access: B3 is the central counterparty for all stock lending (BTC); borrow 1-3%/yr for the liquid names, higher for the rest; banks carry a 30% foreign ownership limit; ON and PN share classes trade separately.
markets.data_notes: Screener is dominated by BDRs (codes ending 34/35/32/33) of foreign issuers: excluded by code pattern and issuer country. One class per issuer (the more liquid of ON/PN).

markets.name: South Africa
markets.access: Naked shorts prohibited by JSE rules; the oldest securities-lending association in the region (1999); securities transfer tax 0.25% on purchases.
markets.data_notes: Cents quotes; several lines are inward listings in USD or GBP and dropped.

markets.name: Greece
markets.msci_note: MSCI 2025 recognised DM-standard lending and short selling
markets.access: EU SSR applies; sales tax 0.1% on sells; ATHEXClear lending; a thin market, kept because the regime is DM-grade.
markets.data_notes: 77 names above $100m; the cross-section is thin for sector neutrality.

markets.name: Mexico
markets.access: A Valpre lending trade must be in place before a short is executed; many names are foreign-accessible only as CPOs without votes; lending tiers by liquidity class; a small cross-section.
markets.data_notes: The screener is dominated by SIC (international quotation system) lines of US stocks: issuer country MX only.

markets.name: Malaysia
markets.access: Regulated short selling only in Bursa's approved-securities list (reviewed semi-annually); SBL via Bursa Clearing; stamp duty 0.1% each side (capped per contract); foreign ownership limits in strategic sectors.
markets.data_notes: none beyond the eligible list.

markets.name: Thailand
markets.access: Shorts only in SET's eligible list (SET100 plus others), uptick rule since July 2024, covered only; foreigners hold most names via NVDRs; the sell-side FTT remains suspended.
markets.data_notes: The screener lists DRs of US names (codes ending 80); excluded by pattern and issuer country. Yahoo has little SET index history; the SET50 ETF is the fallback benchmark.

markets.name: Indonesia
markets.access: Shorts restricted to the IDX eligible list and to 90-day lending contracts (KPEI); sales tax 0.1%; MSCI downgraded information flow in 2026 over free-float opacity.
markets.data_notes: Many names below $1m/day; the ADV floor removes most of the list.

markets.name: Poland
markets.access: EU SSR applies; lending is allowed but not an established practice (MSCI); borrow available for the WIG20 and some mWIG40 names only.
markets.data_notes: The screener lists US cross-listings (AAPL.WA); issuer country PL only.

markets.name: China A shares
markets.access: Margin-lending shorts restricted to an eligible list and curtailed in 2024-25 (securities-lending suspension); QFI or Stock Connect access, 30% aggregate foreign cap; stamp duty 0.05% on sells. Measurement only.
markets.data_notes: Very large screener universe; top 500 by cap above $1bn.

markets.name: Chile
markets.access: Lending and shorting allowed with restrictions, not an established practice.
markets.data_notes: The screener is dominated by foreign CL-suffixed lines (TSLACL.SN); issuer country CL only.

markets.name: Argentina
markets.access: MSCI standalone since 2021 (capital controls; the cepo eased in 2025). BYMA's short-selling and lending framework exists on paper and is barely used, so the book is a measurement. Costs are assumptions, not quotes. Added 2026-11-01 after the EODHD coverage study.
markets.data_notes: EODHD BA: 157 active, 64 delisted common stocks; about 37 names above $0.5m/day; bars from 1994, most names from 2011. ARS inflation: value and size ratios go through USD at the availability date, momentum is nominal. No book populates (2026-11-09): once the 55 CEDEARs are out the universe holds 31 names, at most 19 ever clear the ADV floor against the 25 the ranker needs, so every cell is empty by construction, not a result.

markets.name: Pakistan
markets.access: MSCI frontier (reclassified from emerging in 2021). PSX has short-selling regulations (2019) and a thin SLB market; foreign investors need SECP/SBP registration. Treated as a measurement until the lending and shorting marks are verified against the MSCI review. Costs are assumptions, not quotes. Added 2026-11-01 after the EODHD coverage study.
markets.data_notes: EODHD KAR: 687 active, 1,210 delisted common stocks; about 33 names above $0.5m/day (all of them above $1m); bars from 1995.

markets.name: Philippines
markets.access: PSE short selling programme since November 2023, not yet practised; 40% FOL; 0.6% sales tax.
markets.data_notes: Yahoo's screener serves no listings for the Philippines region (2026-10-31); disabled until a source exists.

markets.name: Vietnam
markets.access: Covered short sales permitted in law since 2021 but not operational; FOL binds; 0.1% sales tax.
markets.data_notes: Yahoo's screener serves no listings for Vietnam (2026-10-31); disabled until a source exists.

source: MSCI 2026 Global Market Accessibility Review (June 2026); regulators; yfinance probes 2026-10-31; EODHD coverage checks 2026-11-07
